SOUL EV
SOUL
A new way to roll®
Presenting the 2016 Kia Soul and Soul EV.† With unique styling, precise handling, and a wealth of
entertainment options, they redefine fun-to-drive. The all-electric Soul EV generates its own
style of excitement while providing an outstanding EPA-estimated range1 of 93 miles on a full
charge. Soul and Soul EV offer an impressive array of available premium features, including the multifaceted
UVO eServices2 Infotainment System*, matched by a wide range of advanced standard safety
systems. All of which means that you have the option of choosing from two great ways to roll.
†Soul EV only available in certain markets with limited availability. 1, 2, * See Features and Specifications pages for availability and endnotes. Not all optional features are available on all trims.

--- page 3 ---
The new definition of excellence
Along with the attention that Soul's unique styling draws on the road, J.D. Power has awarded
the Soul “Highest Ranked Compact Multi-Purpose Vehicle in Initial Quality.”3 The study was
based on an analysis of auto owners' satisfaction during the first 90 days of new-vehicle
ownership. Additionally, Soul's world-class engineering makes it more exciting to drive than
ever, with available features ranging from a 2.0L Gasoline Direct Injection (GDI) engine* to a
panoramic sunroof with power sunshade.* Plus, striking interior styling with soft-touch material
throughout provides a quieter cabin and gives Soul a personality all its own, while three trim
levels along with a choice of packages allow you to add an impressive variety of options. Like
all Kia models, Soul comes with an industry-leading, 10-year/100,000-mile warranty program.4

--- page 4 ---
Uniquely entertaining
Available pulsating multicolored front-door speaker lights* — they’re just one of the features Soul combines
into a fully integrated entertainment system. USB/auxiliary jacks allow you to play your favorite tunes from
your own music library using a compatible MP3 audio player. Soul lets you enjoy that music on an available
Infinity®5 premium sound system with eight speakers, including an external amplifier and a subwoofer*
that provides a concert-like audio experience. In addition, an available UVO eServices2 Infotainment System
with voice-command navigation2* increases your choices in entertainment and convenience.
2, 5, * See Features and Specifications pages for availability and endnotes. Not all optional features are available on all trims. ! (exclaim) WITH UMBER PACKAGE SHOWN.

--- page 5 ---
It's open to almost anything
Soul lets you carry all the cargo6 you need to suit your
lifestyle with an expansive 24.2 cubic feet of available
space. It’s also remarkably versatile thanks to 60/40 split-
folding rear seats. An easy-open liftgate provides quick
access to the roomy cargo area, which also includes a
handy, hidden storage compartment with built-in dividers.

1. 60/40 SPLIT-FOLDING REAR SEATS Conveniently carry longer items, passengers — or
a combination of both — by folding down one or both of the rear seats. 2. REAR-PASSENGER
COMFORT The rear seat has room for three passengers or two passengers and a flip-down
center armrest with dual cup holders. 3. CONCEALED STORAGE The floor of the cargo area flips
up to reveal a hidden compartment for securely carrying smaller items. In addition, a cargo cover
on + (plus) and ! (exclaim) models will keep your things out of view. 4. ROOF-RACK-READY To
carry even more gear, an accessory roof rack is available.† The rack’s mounting points are flush
with the roofline to maintain a streamlined exterior design when the rack is not installed.
The freedom of a panoramic sunroof
If you’ve ever marveled at a sky filled with stars, then you'll appreciate the idea behind
the available panoramic sunroof with power sunshade.* It gives you all the room you need
to let your imagination soar — which is one more reason why, with Soul, the sky’s the limit.
